Radio Prague FAQ

What frequency is Radio Prague on?
In the A-26 season Radio Prague is scheduled on 6 shortwave frequencies, including 5010, 5850, 9820, 9955, 15770, 17790 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 5850 kHz (7:30 pm – 8 pm Eastern). For Europe: 9820 kHz (8 pm – 8:30 pm UTC+1).

Can I hear Radio Prague in the USA?
Yes. Radio Prague is beamed at North America this season on 5010, 5850, 15770 kHz; the best evening option for eastern North America is 5850 kHz (7:30 pm – 8 pm Eastern).

Does Radio Prague broadcast in English on shortwave?
Yes. English broadcasts this season: 5850 kHz at 23:30–24h UTC to W. North America; 9955 kHz at 03:00–03:30 UTC to LAm; 15770 kHz at 22:30–23:00 UTC to E. North America; 17790 kHz at 22:30–23:00 UTC to LAm; 17790 kHz at 23:30–24h UTC to LAm.

Is Radio Prague on the air right now?
As of Wednesday, September 23, 2026, 09:58 UTC, Radio Prague is not currently scheduled to be broadcasting. Next scheduled transmission is 9820 kHz at 17:00 UTC. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
